newsitem.title: EGYPT: National Scieite Generale Bank issuing five-yr FRNs for 150 mln pounds.
newsitem.headline: National Scieite Generale Bank issuing five-yr FRNs for 150 mln pounds.

text.p: Egypt's National Societe Generale Bank said on Sunday it planned to raise 150 million pounds ($44.19 million) for medium-term financing by issuing five-year floating-rate notes denominated in Egyptian pounds.

The bank invited subscriptions to the notes from June 17 onwards and said the offer would remain open for at least 10 days and up to two months. After the 10-day period, it will close as soon as the issue is fully subscribed.

The interest on the notes, paid quarterly, will be 0.25 percentage points a year above the latest average yield on Egyptian 91-day treasury bills. If the treasury has not issued 91-day bills, it will be 2.75 percentage points below the central bank discount rate.
The latest average yield on 91-day bills was 8.888 percent and the discount rate has been 12.25 percent since May 15.
The issuing fee will be 0.25 percent of the nominal value. The notes will be available in 1,000-pound units.
The bank may redeem the bonds afetr the first four years.

The bank forecast that its net profits would increase to 65 million pounds in 1997, 75 million in 1998, 86 million in 1999, 99 million in 2000, 114 million in 2001 and 131 million in 2002. Net profits in 1996 were 57 million pounds.
